Call any NHL endpoint

Source: R/request.R
nhl_api.Rd

The escape hatch: a GET against one of the NHL's APIs, returned as parsed JSON (nested lists). Every other function in the package is built on it.

Usage

nhl_api(
  path,
  api = c("web", "stats", "records", "search"),
  query = list(),
  tidy = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Path below the API's base URL, e.g. "score/now".

api

Which API: "web" (api-web.nhle.com/v1), "stats" (api.nhle.com/stats/rest/en), "records" (records.nhl.com/site/api) or "search" (search.d3.nhle.com/api/v1).

query

Named list of query parameters.

tidy

If TRUE, the result goes through tidy_json().

Value

The parsed response.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
nhl_api("partner-game/US/now")
nhl_api("glossary", api = "stats", tidy = TRUE)
}
